title: Tours/Interviews booking: auth-gated page, reliable confirmation, contact form, errors, and request listing

requirements.summary: Require Internet Identity sign-in for /tours by gating the booking page behind the existing RequireAuth/AuthPanel.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /tours while signed out shows the existing AuthPanel (via RequireAuth) instead of the booking UI.
When signed in, the booking UI is available and booking submission calls the backend successfully (no authorization trap).

file_operations.description: Wrap the /tours route component with RequireAuth so signed-out users see AuthPanel and cannot access booking/listing UI until authenticated (per the authorization component guidance). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make the booking confirmation modal reliably show after success with the correct submitted values (date/time, details, booking ID) and be closable to reset to a ready state.
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful booking submission, a confirmation modal is displayed without requiring any additional user action.
The modal shows the submitted date/time (not cleared/undefined), the submitted details, and the returned booking ID.
Closing the modal hides it and leaves the page in a ready state for another booking request.

file_operations.description: Refactor submission state to snapshot submitted values (submittedDate/submittedDetails/submittedContact/submittedNotes/submittedBookingId) before clearing form inputs, and render BookingConfirmation from the snapshot so it never depends on cleared state.

Update BookingConfirmation props and rendering to display the submitted date/time, submitted details, and booking ID from the post-submit snapshot (not from live form state), and ensure close action hides modal cleanly.

requirements.summary: Add parent contact fields (name, email) and optional notes to the booking form, and submit them in the booking request payload.
acceptanceCriteria: The /tours page includes inputs for parent name and parent email, plus the existing free-text notes field.
The submit button is disabled until required fields (date/time, name, email) are provided.
The backend persists the collected information with the booking request such that it is visible when listing bookings (e.g., in the 'Your Tour Requests' list).

file_operations.description: Add controlled inputs for parent name and parent email (required) plus an optional notes textarea (keep existing free-text field as notes or clearly separate notes vs details), validate required fields, and disable submit until date/time + name + email are present.
Update useCreateBooking to call the backend using the BookingInput shape (requestedTime, details, notes, contact{name,email}) as defined in frontend/src/backend.d.ts, and adjust types accordingly.

requirements.summary: Show clear user-facing error feedback on booking submission failures and keep the pending/loading state preventing duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria: If booking submission fails, the UI displays an English error message on the page (or in a modal/alert area) explaining that the request could not be submitted.
While submission is pending, the existing loading state remains visible and prevents duplicate submissions.

file_operations.description: Add an on-page error message area for submission failures (including authorization/network errors) and clear the error on new attempts; keep the existing pending state to disable the submit button and prevent duplicate submissions (handle errors per authorization component guidance). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: List the signed-in user's stored tour requests on /tours and refresh the list after new submissions with a clear empty state when none exist.
acceptanceCriteria: After submitting a booking, the stored requests list updates to include the new request without a full page reload.
The list displays each request's requested date/time, submitted details/contact info, and status.
If there are no bookings, the page does not show an empty list block (or shows a clear empty state message).

file_operations.description: Update listing logic to support 'my bookings' behavior for the UI (e.g., filter results to the signed-in principal when appropriate) and ensure the react-query cache invalidation/refetch keeps the list up-to-date after create.

Render a 'Your Tour Requests' section that shows requested date/time, status, and submitted contact info + details/notes; add a clear empty state when there are no bookings; ensure the list updates immediately after successful creation via query invalidation.
